trello.name: Renew and deploy SSL certificates with auto-renewal
trello.desc: Ben to renew and deploy the wildcard SSL certificate for api.ourapp.com to the load balancers by August 22nd, ahead of the September 1st expiry. Also rotate the internal CA certificate that signs the service mesh, which expires two weeks after the public cert, within the same change window. Move both certificates onto cert-manager so they auto-renew going forward.

trello.name: PDF export feature for reports
trello.desc: Aisha to implement PDF export for reports by end of month. Deliverable includes backend rendering reports to PDF using headless Chrome and frontend adding an export button with a progress state for large reports. Also record a short demo GIF of the export feature for the changelog as part of finishing the feature.

trello.name: Restore staging environment parity
trello.desc: Ben to run the three pending staging migrations today to catch staging up to production, and write a nightly job that diffs the staging schema against production and posts to the infra channel if they diverge.
